args.query: coefficient of multivariate Hasse derivative equals binomial coefficient times shifted coefficient

items.name: LaurentSeries.hasseDeriv_coeff
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : Semiring R] {V : Type u_2} [inst_1 : AddCommGroup V] [inst_2 : Module R V] (k : ℕ)
  (f : LaurentSeries V) (n : ℤ), ((LaurentSeries.hasseDeriv R k) f).coeff n = Ring.choose (n + ↑k) k • f.coeff (n + ↑k)

items.name: Polynomial.hasseDeriv_coeff
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : Semiring R] (k : ℕ) (f : Polynomial R) (n : ℕ),
  ((Polynomial.hasseDeriv k) f).coeff n = ↑((n + k).choose k) * f.coeff (n + k)

items.name: Polynomial.hasseDeriv_apply
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : Semiring R] (k : ℕ) (f : Polynomial R),
  (Polynomial.hasseDeriv k) f = f.sum fun i r => (Polynomial.monomial (i - k)) (↑(i.choose k) * r)

items.name: Polynomial.hasseDeriv_monomial
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : Semiring R] (k n : ℕ) (r : R),
  (Polynomial.hasseDeriv k) ((Polynomial.monomial n) r) = (Polynomial.monomial (n - k)) (↑(n.choose k) * r)

items.name: LaurentSeries.hasseDeriv
items.type:
(R : Type u_2) →
  {V : Type u_3} →
    [inst : AddCommGroup V] → [inst_1 : Semiring R] → [inst_2 : Module R V] → ℕ → LaurentSeries V →ₗ[R] LaurentSeries V

items.name: LaurentSeries.hasseDeriv_single
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : Semiring R] {V : Type u_2} [inst_1 : AddCommGroup V] [inst_2 : Module R V] (k : ℕ) (n : ℤ)
  (x : V), (LaurentSeries.hasseDeriv R k) ((HahnSeries.single n) x) = (HahnSeries.single (n - ↑k)) (Ring.choose n k • x)

items.name: Polynomial.taylor_coeff
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : Semiring R] (r : R) (f : Polynomial R) (n : ℕ),
  ((Polynomial.taylor r) f).coeff n = Polynomial.eval r ((Polynomial.hasseDeriv n) f)

items.name: LaurentSeries.hasseDeriv_single_add
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : Semiring R] {V : Type u_2} [inst_1 : AddCommGroup V] [inst_2 : Module R V] (k : ℕ) (n : ℤ)
  (x : V),
  (LaurentSeries.hasseDeriv R k) ((HahnSeries.single (n + ↑k)) x) = (HahnSeries.single n) (Ring.choose (n + ↑k) k • x)
